title: Self-consistent DFT calculation
action: Perform a self-consistent DFT calculation using a plane-wave pseudopotential code (LDA or GGA) for the Y₂Br₂C₂ crystal structure (monoclinic C2/m, a=695.3 pm, b=376.4 pm, c=993.8 pm, β=99.98°, atomic positions: Y(0.4040,0,0.1485), Br(0.7901,0,0.3333), C(0.0861,0,0.0361)). Obtain the converged electronic charge density and the band structure along the high-symmetry path Γ‑A‑M‑Γ‑Z‑V‑Γ.

title: Extract electronic structure results
action: From the self-consistent DFT output, compute the total density of states (DOS) and extract its value at the Fermi level (dos_at_ef, in states/eV/spin). Identify the bands crossing E_F; determine their orbital character and dispersion. Identify the band that is relatively flat; examine whether it exhibits a saddle point near Γ (saddle_point_present = true or false). Report the predominant orbital character of that flat band (flat_band_character) and the high‑symmetry k‑path used (k_path_description). Write the results to electronic_structure_results.json.
description: JSON file containing the main electronic structure results needed to verify the paper's computational claim.
